title: Behavioral
summary: One real story from your work, a few sharp follow ups, and what you learned.

phases.title: Story
phases.goal: Open in about twenty words: first name, round and length, then the card's question. Two or three probes on what they did, the stakes, and the result.

phases.title: Lesson
phases.goal: Ask what they took away or would do differently. Close and call end_round.
